label: Frame limiter
description: Lowers the frame rate while the game is in the background, in a menu, or minimised.
settings_description: Settings for the Frame limiter gameplay mod. None of these caps ever applies while you are in the world with the window focused — that frame rate is the one you set in Minecraft's options, untouched. Vanilla 1.8.9 renders a backgrounded or minimised window as fast as it can, so a game left on a second monitor heats the GPU the player is about to need for something else. The menu cap covers the title screen, the server list and the pause menu; it never covers an inventory or a chest, because the fight carries on behind those.

unfocused_fps.description: Frame cap while the game window does not have focus. 30 keeps a game on a second monitor watchable while giving most of the GPU back.

menu_fps.description: Frame cap on the title screen, the server list and the pause menu. Vanilla already holds the title screen at 30; 60 is smoother than that and still a fraction of an uncapped menu.

idle_minimized.description: Whether a minimised window drops to 5 frames a second. Nothing is visible, so nothing is lost; sound and the connection carry on.
